result.title: AnyPrune: Optimization-Free Pruning for Any Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting Pipeline
result.summary: Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipelines reconstruct a scene from images in a single forward pass, representing it as real-time-renderable 3D Gaussians. However, the resulting representations contain far more Gaussians than are needed to render the scene faithfully, especially when there are many input views. This drastically increases memory and storage requirements. Existing pruning methods either require costly re-optimization, which defeats the purpose of a single forward pass, or rely on simple strategies that do not exploit all the available information. We present AnyPrune, a transformer-based, optimization-free pruning module designed to work on top of any feedforward 3DGS pipeline. To remove unnecessary Gaussians, AnyPrune learns and exploits pipeline-specific redundancy patterns through a short single-GPU training on the frozen target feedforward pipeline. AnyPrune achieves better rendering quality than existing optimization-free pruning methods in most settings and generalizes to unseen datasets, as shown through extensive experiments across multiple feedforward pipelines, datasets, and input view counts. It prunes a 1.6M-Gaussian field in about $5\,\mathrm{s}$ on a consumer GPU, faster than every method that merges Gaussians or re-optimizes the field. It can also be combined with the pruning built into feedforward pipelines, pruning further at moderate ratios while preserving or improving rendering quality. Finally, it can even suggest a scene-specific pruning ratio that retains most of the quality.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 AnyPrune，一个在冻结的前馈 3DGS 管线之上用少量单卡训练学到的 transformer 剪枝模块，用于去除渲染不需要的高斯，从而在无需再优化的情况下降低内存与存储开销，并可在 5 秒内剪掉 1.6M 高斯。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在冻结主干上学习冗余模式、按内容删除表示元素」的做法，可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 中 latent 状态或视觉 token 的冗余判定与动态预算控制，但场景是 3D 重建而非多模态推理，联系较弱。
